description: Rank and screen 2 to 10 Great Britain postcodes by a specific target metric (affluence, house price, crime safety, broadband speed, family suitability, or connectivity). Returns a sorted leaderboard. For 11 to 50 postcodes use enrich_postcodes; for full cross-metric comparison of 2 to 5 postcodes use compare_postcodes.

metric.description: Target metric to rank postcodes by: "affluence" (1-100 score), "house_price" (median GBP), "crime_safety" (IMD crime decile), "broadband_speed" (gigabit availability), "family_suitability" (1-100 score), or "connectivity" (transit & broadband).

order.description: Sort order: "desc" (highest first, default) or "asc" (lowest first).

postcodes.description: List of 2 to 10 Great Britain postcodes to screen and rank (e.g. ["SW1A 1AA", "BB7 3BB", "M1 1AE"]). Maximum 10 postcodes.

name: screen_postcodes
title: Screen & Rank Great Britain Postcodes
